```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Paths relative to this file's location
project_dir <- ".."
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_functions.rda"))

paths       <- setup_project_paths(project_dir)
tables_dir  <- paths$tables_dir
figures_dir <- paths$figures_dir
output_dir  <- paths$output_dir
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)

# Shared colour palette for dissertation figures
load(file.path(project_dir, "project_colours.rda"))
```

```{r load-pca-samples}
# Sample-level PCA scores (93 samples), joined against mean cell volume
# per sample - the direct validation behind cor_PC1_vol/cor_PC2_vol used
# elsewhere (scripts 03/06/09). PC1 correlates with size in WT, but this
# is lost once TOR/PKA-disrupting mutants are included - PC1 is the
# TOR/PKA-mediated route from size to transcription, PC2 is a separate,
# unexplained size-dependency. strain_info distinguishes WT vs mutant.
pca_samples <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_samples_AC.txt"),
                        show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(mean_cell_volume))

# TOR/PKA-disrupting mutants (per strain_info): AID-Bcy1, TPK1-3_AS,
# TOR1-L2134M, Sch9(2d3E), Sch9(2d3E)_Tod6-mNG, Gtr2(s23L)-Gtr1(q65L).
# Hog1-AID and Pkc1-AID excluded - they perturb osmotic/cell wall
# signalling, not TOR/PKA.
tor_pka_mutants <- c("AID-Bcy1", "TPK1-3_AS", "TOR1-L2134M",
                     "Sch9(2d3E)", "Sch9(2d3E)_Tod6-mNG",
                     "Gtr2(s23L)-Gtr1(q65L)")

# WT-background cells chemically treated with a TOR/PKA inhibitor
# (Torin, Rapamycin, 1NMPP1, in any combination) are reclassified out
# of "WT" - matched via str_detect() on `condition` so combined
# conditions (e.g. "Torin+PhIAA") are also caught. PhIAA-only WT stays
# WT (no AID tag, so it's a drug control). ATC-treated WT is excluded
# entirely (off-trend in diagnostics, cause unconfirmed) rather than
# classified either way.
pca_samples <- pca_samples %>%
  mutate(
    strain_group = case_when(
      strain_info == "WT" &
        str_detect(condition, "Torin|Rapa|1NMPP1")     ~ "TOR/PKA mutant",  # chemical
      strain_info == "WT" &
        condition == "ATC"                             ~ "Excluded (unconfirmed)",
      strain_info == "WT"                              ~ "WT",
      strain_info %in% tor_pka_mutants                  ~ "TOR/PKA mutant",  # genetic
      TRUE                                              ~ "Other mutant"
    )
  )

cat("Samples by strain group:\n")
print(table(pca_samples$strain_group))

# Sanity check: no chemically TOR-inhibited or ATC-treated WT remains
# classified as WT (should show only OD 0.1/OD 0.3 and PhIAA)
cat("\nConditions retained under strain_group == 'WT':\n")
pca_samples %>%
  filter(strain_info == "WT", strain_group == "WT") %>%
  distinct(condition, strain_info_condition_easy) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

# Correlations computed three ways: all samples, WT only, TOR/PKA
# mutants only - tests whether PC1's size correlation depends on
# TOR/PKA state.
compute_cor <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      n           = n(),
      cor_PC1_vol = cor(PC1, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman"),
      cor_PC2_vol = cor(PC2, mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")
    )
}

pca_samples_analysis <- pca_samples %>%
  filter(strain_group != "Excluded (unconfirmed)")

pc_vol_cor_all <- compute_cor(pca_samples_analysis) %>% mutate(group = "All samples")
pc_vol_cor_wt  <- pca_samples_analysis %>% filter(strain_group == "WT") %>%
  compute_cor() %>% mutate(group = "WT only")
pc_vol_cor_mut <- pca_samples_analysis %>% filter(strain_group == "TOR/PKA mutant") %>%
  compute_cor() %>% mutate(group = "TOR/PKA mutant only")

pc_vol_cor <- bind_rows(pc_vol_cor_all, pc_vol_cor_wt, pc_vol_cor_mut) %>%
  select(group, n, cor_PC1_vol, cor_PC2_vol)

cat("\nPC1/PC2 vs cell volume correlation, by strain group:\n")
print(pc_vol_cor)
```

```{r fisher-z-test}
# Fisher r-to-z test: is the WT correlation significantly different
# from the TOR/PKA-mutant correlation?
fisher_z_test <- function(r1, n1, r2, n2) {
  z1 <- atanh(r1)
  z2 <- atanh(r2)
  se <- sqrt(1 / (n1 - 3) + 1 / (n2 - 3))
  z  <- (z1 - z2) / se
  p  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
  tibble(z_statistic = z, p_value = p)
}

n_wt  <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "WT only") %>% pull(n)
n_mut <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "TOR/PKA mutant only") %>% pull(n)

r1_pc1 <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "WT only") %>% pull(cor_PC1_vol)
r2_pc1 <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "TOR/PKA mutant only") %>% pull(cor_PC1_vol)
r1_pc2 <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "WT only") %>% pull(cor_PC2_vol)
r2_pc2 <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "TOR/PKA mutant only") %>% pull(cor_PC2_vol)

fisher_pc1 <- fisher_z_test(r1_pc1, n_wt, r2_pc1, n_mut) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "PC1: WT vs TOR/PKA mutant", .before = 1)
fisher_pc2 <- fisher_z_test(r1_pc2, n_wt, r2_pc2, n_mut) %>%
  mutate(comparison = "PC2: WT vs TOR/PKA mutant", .before = 1)

fisher_results <- bind_rows(fisher_pc1, fisher_pc2)

cat("\nFisher r-to-z test, WT vs TOR/PKA-mutant correlations:\n")
print(fisher_results)

cat("\nNote: Spearman correlations were used above, but Fisher's z\n",
    "formally applies to Pearson r. Treat p-values here as approximate.\n", sep = "")
```

```{r permutation-test}
# Permutation test for the difference in Spearman correlations between
# WT and TOR/PKA-mutant samples - no distributional assumptions,
# reshuffles group labels and compares to the observed difference.
set.seed(42)
n_perm <- 10000

# Restrict to WT + TOR/PKA mutant only, matching the Fisher test scope
# (excludes "Other mutant")
perm_data <- pca_samples %>%
  filter(strain_group %in% c("WT", "TOR/PKA mutant"))

permutation_test <- function(perm_data, pc_col) {
  observed_wt  <- perm_data %>% filter(strain_group == "WT") %>%
    summarise(r = cor(.data[[pc_col]], mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")) %>% pull(r)
  observed_mut <- perm_data %>% filter(strain_group == "TOR/PKA mutant") %>%
    summarise(r = cor(.data[[pc_col]], mean_cell_volume, method = "spearman")) %>% pull(r)
  observed_diff <- observed_wt - observed_mut

  n_wt  <- sum(perm_data$strain_group == "WT")
  n_tot <- nrow(perm_data)

  perm_diffs <- map_dbl(seq_len(n_perm), function(i) {
    shuffled_labels <- sample(perm_data$strain_group)
    r_wt  <- cor(perm_data[[pc_col]][shuffled_labels == "WT"],
                perm_data$mean_cell_volume[shuffled_labels == "WT"],
                method = "spearman")
    r_mut <- cor(perm_data[[pc_col]][shuffled_labels == "TOR/PKA mutant"],
                perm_data$mean_cell_volume[shuffled_labels == "TOR/PKA mutant"],
                method = "spearman")
    r_wt - r_mut
  })

  p_value <- mean(abs(perm_diffs) >= abs(observed_diff))

  tibble(
    r_wt = observed_wt, r_mutant = observed_mut,
    observed_diff = observed_diff, p_value = p_value
  )
}

perm_pc1 <- permutation_test(perm_data, "PC1") %>% mutate(comparison = "PC1", .before = 1)
perm_pc2 <- permutation_test(perm_data, "PC2") %>% mutate(comparison = "PC2", .before = 1)

permutation_results <- bind_rows(perm_pc1, perm_pc2)

cat("\nPermutation test (n =", n_perm, "shuffles), WT vs TOR/PKA-mutant",
    "difference in Spearman r:\n")
print(permutation_results)
```

```{r plot-pc1-vs-volume}
# WT highlighted separately from TOR/PKA and other mutants. ATC-treated
# WT samples are dropped via pca_samples_analysis (no colour mapping,
# so they're excluded deliberately rather than dropped silently).
strain_colours <- c(
  "WT"             = project_colours[["red"]],
  "TOR/PKA mutant" = project_colours[["purple"]],
  "Other mutant"   = project_colours[["grey"]]
)

axis_theme_big <- theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.text       = element_text(size = 17, colour = "black"),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 19, colour = "black"),
    plot.subtitle   = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 18)
  )

wt_cor  <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "WT only") %>% pull(cor_PC1_vol)
all_cor <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "All samples") %>% pull(cor_PC1_vol)

p_pc1_vol <- ggplot(pca_samples_analysis, aes(x = mean_cell_volume, y = PC1)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = strain_group), alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(data = pca_samples_analysis %>% filter(strain_group == "WT"),
             method = "lm", color = project_colours[["red"]],
             se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE,
             linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = strain_colours, name = "Strain") +
  labs(
    subtitle = paste0(
      "n = ", nrow(pca_samples_analysis), " samples  |  ",
      "WT only: r = ", round(wt_cor, 3), "  |  ",
      "All samples: r = ", round(all_cor, 3)
    ),
    x = "Mean cell volume (fL)",
    y = "PC1 sample score"
  ) +
  axis_theme_big

print(p_pc1_vol)
```

```{r plot-pc2-vs-volume}
wt_cor2  <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "WT only") %>% pull(cor_PC2_vol)
all_cor2 <- pc_vol_cor %>% filter(group == "All samples") %>% pull(cor_PC2_vol)

p_pc2_vol <- ggplot(pca_samples_analysis, aes(x = mean_cell_volume, y = PC2)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = strain_group), alpha = 0.7, size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = strain_colours, name = "Strain") +
  labs(
    subtitle = paste0(
      "n = ", nrow(pca_samples_analysis), " samples  |  ",
      "WT only: r = ", round(wt_cor2, 3), "  |  ",
      "All samples: r = ", round(all_cor2, 3)
    ),
    x = "Mean cell volume (fL)",
    y = "PC2 sample score"
  ) +
  axis_theme_big

print(p_pc2_vol)
```

```{r combined-panel}
# Side-by-side panel for the dissertation: PC1 tracks volume in WT
# (solid red trend) but is diluted with TOR/PKA mutants included
# (dashed black, all samples). PC2 tracks volume regardless of strain.
p_combined <- (p_pc1_vol + p_pc2_vol) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 2, guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(p_combined)
```

```{r save-outputs}
write_tsv(pc_vol_cor, file.path(output_dir, "pc_vs_cell_volume_correlations.txt"))
write_tsv(fisher_results, file.path(output_dir, "pc_vs_cell_volume_fisher_z_test.txt"))
write_tsv(permutation_results, file.path(output_dir, "pc_vs_cell_volume_permutation_test.txt"))

ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_pc1_vs_cell_volume.png"),
       plot = p_pc1_vol, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_pc2_vs_cell_volume.png"),
       plot = p_pc2_vol, width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "figure_pc1_pc2_vs_cell_volume_combined.png"),
       plot = p_combined, width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300)
```
